rationale: The two solutions are functionally and structurally the same. Both use the same sentinel errors, the same switch that maps characters to digits, the same overflow check before each multiply-accumulate step, and the same HandleErrors classification using errors.Is. The only differences are cosmetic: B declares maxInt64 at package level rather than inside the function, and the comments and error message wording differ slightly. None of these changes the quality of the code in any meaningful way.
